description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Chameleon.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Chameleon.
Activate Chameleon by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Chameleon ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Chameleon, Master of Disguise
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
